notes.n14: BMW F22 220i six-speed manual RWD with the 1998 cc engine, from the 07/2016 sheet. The Getrag GS6-17BG subtype is derived from the sibling F32 420i sheet. The 1997 cc 2014-2015 220i has its own row.
notes.n15: BMW F22 220i eight-speed Steptronic RWD with the 1998 cc engine, 2016-2021 (07/2016 and 03/2021 sheets). BMW publishes "8-speed Steptronic"; the ZF GA8HP45Z code is derived. The 1997 cc 2014-2015 220i has its own row.
notes.n16: Reverse gear: the 07/2016 and 03/2021 F22 sheets print 3.456 for the eight-speed Steptronic.
notes.n17: BMW F22 228i six-speed manual RWD, 2014-2016: the 07/2014 ACEA sheet lists it (1997 cc, 180 kW) and the 07/2016 sheet lists the 230i instead. Top gear 0.701, reverse 3.187, final drive 3.909, standard tyre 205/50 R17. The Getrag GS6-17BG subtype is derived.
notes.n18: BMW F22 228i eight-speed Steptronic RWD, 2014-2016. The 07/2014 ACEA sheet lists 4.714 / 3.143 / 2.106 / 1.667 / 1.285 / 1.000 / 0.839 / 0.667, reverse 3.295, final drive 3.077 and standard tyre 205/50 R17.
notes.n19: BMW F22 230i six-speed manual RWD. The 230i first appears in the 07/2016 sheet (1998 cc, 185 kW). Top gear 0.677, final drive 3.909, standard tyre 205/50 R17. The 03/2021 sheet lists the 230i with the automatic only, so the manual ends by 2020.
notes.n20: BMW F22 230i eight-speed Steptronic RWD, 2016-2021. The 07/2016 and 03/2021 sheets list 5.000 / 3.200 / 2.143 / 1.720 / 1.314 / 1.000 / 0.822 / 0.640, reverse 3.456 and final drive 2.813, standard tyre 205/50 R17.
